mapper.sql: e.id, e.class_id, e.title, e.description, e.cover_image, e.type, e.duration, e.total_score, e.pass_score, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.allow_retake, e.max_attempts, e.shuffle_questions, e.shuffle_options, e.show_answer, e.auto_grade, e.creator_id, e.status, e.create_time, e.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , c.name AS class_name, t.real_name AS creator_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_question eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.id) AS question_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT er.student_id) FROM exam_record er WHERE er.exam_id = e.id) AS student_count FROM exam e LEFT JOIN class c ON e.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON e.creator_id = t.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT , c.name AS class_name, t.real_name AS creator_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_question eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.id) AS question_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT er.student_id) FROM exam_record er WHERE er.exam_id = e.id) AS student_count FROM exam e LEFT JOIN class c ON e.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON e.creator_id = t.id WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} AND e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.start_time ASC, e.create_time DESC
